key.overloadcore.status: Core Status / Sneak to Toggle Diagnostics
overloadcore.lore: Rated power is only a suggestion.
overloadcore.warning: Cannot be removed in survival. Kept on death.
overloadcore.effects: Within %s blocks: owned/shared machines draw double power; generation and transport are reduced.
overloadcore.benefits: Selected recipes produce more; excess power can recharge your gear.
overloadcore.details_hint: Hold use for two seconds to bind. K: details; sneak + K: diagnostics.
overloadcore.hold_bind: Keep holding use for two seconds to permanently equip the core.
overloadcore.no_slot: An empty Core accessory slot is required.
overloadcore.foreign_core: This core is bound to another wearer.
overloadcore.sharing_hint: Aim at your device: /overloadcore share <player>; use unshare to revoke.
overloadcore.not_owner: Aim at a device you own.
death.attack.overloadcore.electric: %1$s was struck down by a short circuit
overloadcore.curse.0: Welded bond: cannot be removed in survival; kept on death.
overloadcore.curse.1: Parasitic resistance: double working energy cost.
overloadcore.curse.2: Phase loss: half the generated energy.
overloadcore.curse.3: Short circuit: nearby working machines shock and repel you.
overloadcore.curse.4: Bus congestion: reduced delivery at affected endpoints.
overloadcore.curse.5: Interference: louder machines; prolonged noise causes nausea.
overloadcore.curse.6: Magnetic load: too much carried metal prevents sprinting.
overloadcore.curse.7: Thermal stress: heat exposure builds up and eventually hurts.
overloadcore.gift.0: Yield: selected ore-entry and basic-component outputs are doubled.
overloadcore.gift.1: Recovery: 25% of the extra energy can charge carried gear.
overloadcore.gift.2: Resonance: a powered MekaTool mines 25% faster.
overloadcore.gift.3: Diagnostics: locate nearby permitted devices and heat sources.
